name: ArraySubs – Subscription Manager for WooCommerce
author: Emran

sections.description:
ArraySubs is a powerful subscription management plugin for WooCommerce that enables businesses to offer flexible subscription products with recurring billing, trial periods, and comprehensive customer management features.

Key Features:

  • Flexible subscription products with customizable billing cycles
  • Trial periods and signup fees
  • Renewal billing and payment management
  • Customer subscription portal
  • Plan switching and upgrades/downgrades
  • Refund and proration management
  • Email notifications

Support

For support, please visit our documentation or contact the development team.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/arraysubscription directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Configure subscription settings in the ArraySubs dashboard
  4. Create subscription products as needed
sections.faq:
How do I create a subscription product?

Navigate to Products > Add New (or edit existing product), and select “Subscription” as the product type. Configure the billing cycle, amount, and other subscription parameters.

Can customers manage their subscriptions?

Yes! Customers can view, pause, resume, and cancel their subscriptions from their account dashboard.

What payment gateways are supported?

ArraySubs integrates with WooCommerce’s payment gateway system. Supported gateways depend on your WooCommerce setup.
